name: OpenPort Process-Local Action Execution Coordination Profile v0.3
summary: Executable reference profile for application-scoped, request-fingerprint-bound single-flight coordination of retry-equivalent action executions within one runtime process.
claimBoundary: This profile closes an evaluated in-process check-before-effect race only. It is not crash-safe, durable, multi-host, exactly-once, or evidence about private Accentrust production architecture.

checks.description: Concurrent executions with one application-scoped idempotency key and one action fingerprint MUST share one in-flight execution in the process-local profile.
evidence: sixteen concurrent equivalent calls invoke the protected callback once
fifteen callers are labeled as replays
all callers observe the same synthetic effect identifier

checks.description: Reuse of an in-flight scoped key with a different action fingerprint MUST fail closed.
A failed in-flight callback MUST release its process-local claim so an explicit later retry can run under the same fingerprint.
evidence: later equivalent retry executes as a new leader
